description:
Email marketing is vital to any eComm brand strategy. But your emails are useless if they don’t actually make it to a user's inbox. 

In this episode of Work In Public, I’m talking with Tyler Paschke, the VP of Data & Analytics at Retention, all about the topic of email deliverability 📬

From understanding the importance of sender reputation and authentication protocols to optimizing email content and engagement metrics, we explore the essential steps you need to take to improve deliverability rates and avoid spam filters. 

If you want to enhance your brand's email marketing effectiveness and drive greater customer engagement, this episode is going to bring a ton of value. 

Don’t miss the full episode over on YouTube!
